### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **1** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **144** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e649c2d91e270e3da26820bcfe54a28445305a75` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · #25511 · `domain:spec` seat 2 (seat post #18549) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_01PC4NPXPgPmpDRG9DdDnyXT` · 2026-10-24T09:21Z · head `0ed74f8840` · report `6382456646` · self-review at `TIER_DEFAULT` (a `packages/spec` describe-text surface, this lane's own).

1. **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #25511`, with no other closing keyword in the body. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: semantic` are line-initial in the body and in `.changeset/25511-hide-empty-describe.md` (`@objectstack/spec` `minor`). Three files, +30/−2, all inside the claim's surface (`get_files`): `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx`, the changeset. No governed path, no `content/docs/releases/`.
2. **Premise and ruling, measured.** The describe now states ruling C on objectstack-ai/objectui#13386: with `false`, read-only renders the heading plus one fold row; edit mode renders every row, editable. The default is unchanged ("renders nothing at all"), and no key, shape or default changed. I checked the changeset's sentences against objectui `origin/main` `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx`. "A partly-filled section's empty rows are not governed by this key, in either value" matches its comment at about `:302`–`:306` ("authored `hideEmpty` does NOT override this branch in either polarity"). The all-empty hide is `section.hideEmpty === true && allFieldsEmpty && !isEditing` at about `:366`. Not quoting the fold label is right: the label belongs to objectui (`detail.showEmptyFields`, "Show COUNT empty fields", interpolated, about `:829`).
3. **Gates.** Check-runs on `0ed74f8840` at this record: 21 success, 6 skipped, 12 in progress (Test Core 1–6/6, Build Core, Build Docs, three Type Check lanes, one scoped Lint), 0 failed. Local: spec `test` 714/714 files, `check:generated` up to date after `gen:docs`, `--ran` 106 run / 1 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, declared narrowing; CI runs it). Landing waits for every check green on this head.
4. **Deviations accepted.** (a) `origin/main` merged once before the PR opened (`e649c2d91e`, the Version Packages merge) through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`, with no conflict and re-tested on the merge head. (b) `git fetch --unshallow` on the shared clone, additive. (c) Targeted builds only, declared. (d) A model-free commit trailer pair, per AGENTS.md. `mcp_calls` 0; relay writes 2.
5. **Out-of-scope outcomes.**
   - Renderer lag until objectstack-ai/objectui#13386 lands: dropped — ordered by the ruling, and carried by that card (`pm:blocked` on #25511).
   - The default's edit-mode rendering has no mode qualifier in the describe: Acceptance notes (the old text had the same wording; no author writes wrong metadata because of it).
   - The stale test comment at `packages/spec/src/ui/component.test.ts` about `:636`: Acceptance notes (no assertion reads it).
6. **Landing.** Not governed and under 3000 changed lines, so the seat lands it. Once every check on the then-current head is green or an expected skip, the seat sends `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` through the relay. The maintainer's hold 「正在发版本，你可以派发但是不要合并。」 is read as ended by their word 「objectstack 已发布 18.1」 in the seat's session. On merge, objectstack-ai/objectui#13386 unblocks.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0ed74f8840010e01c98092eb792a7dbd51208b51`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts + content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx, .changeset/25511-hide-empty-describe.md, sdui.manifest.json (read, unchanged), objectui packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx and objectui packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts (read at objectui origin/main 798138418d, the tree the PR cites as 7981384)

Inputs read: card #25511 (body and all three comments), ruling C on objectstack-ai/objectui#13386 (body, ruling comment 6369306878, triage comment 6370301339), PR #25612 body and file list, the net diff of merge-base e649c2d91e to the head (three files, +30/-2), and the 47 check-runs on the head: 37 success, 10 skipped (opt-in harnesses, the filtered dogfood/pin/temporal jobs), 0 failed, no legacy commit statuses. The dispatching seat's PR comment was not read before this verdict was formed.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set: unchanged — right.** `hideEmpty` stays `z.boolean().optional()` with no schema default; no refinement, key, shape or export moves. `check:api-surface` (public API surface unchanged) and `check:authorable-surface` are green on the head; `json-schema.manifest/ui.json` lists schema ids and `authorable-surface*.json` lists keys, neither carries describe text, both correctly untouched.
- **The one public surface that moves is the `describe()` string**, which the shipped JSON Schema `description` and the reference doc read. Read against ruling C (objectui#13386, comment 6369306878): default unchanged (on, an all-empty section renders nothing); `false` in read-only mode renders the heading plus one fold row that counts the empty fields and reveals them on request, the mixed-section fold; `false` in edit mode renders every row editable; no new key. The new text states all four and nothing more — **right**. The card's done-when (what `false` renders in read-only AND edit mode) is met on the one producer the card named; no other producer of the old phrase exists outside the generated mdx, a test comment and the release-owned CHANGELOG.
- **Lead change, "Whether this section disappears when ALL its fields are empty" — right, verified on the renderer.** objectui DetailSection.tsx at origin/main 798138418d reads the key once: `hideAllEmptySection = section.hideEmpty === true && allFieldsEmpty && !isEditing`. The partly-filled auto-hide (`shouldAutoHideEmpty`, requires `filledCount` above zero) and its toggle are not overridden by the key in either polarity, as the renderer's own comment (objectui#7129 Q2-C) and sdui.manifest.json already tell authors. The key governs the all-empty case only, so the old lead "Hide this section's empty fields" was the inaccurate one and the new lead is the narrower, true claim.
- **"the same fold a partly-filled section uses" — right.** The renderer's existing control is the `detail.showEmptyFields` / `detail.hideEmptyFields` toggle (en: "Show COUNT empty fields" with the count hole, and "Hide empty fields"). The text describes that row by function and quotes no label. The card's parenthetical "N empty fields · Show" is the card's gloss of the ruling's 「N 个空字段 · 展开」, not an objectui string; pinning either into the spec would claim a label the spec does not own and the renderer does not print. Wording call 1 stands.
- **"in edit mode it renders every field as an editable row" — right.** Both hide branches in the renderer carry `!isEditing`.
- **Docblock paragraph — right.** Records the ruling and the all-empty-only domain above the key; not author-facing, so the tracker citations are in the same register as the surrounding docblock; `check:doc-authoring` is clean on the describe strings.
- **Generated artefacts — right.** `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` row regenerated and byte-equal to the describe string; `check:docs` and `check:generated` are green (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`). `sdui.manifest.json` still carries objectui's "label skeleton" sentence for `hideEmpty: false` and is **right to leave untouched**: it is regenerated from objectui's built tree at the `.objectui-sha` pin (2958f17e9c), it is objectui-owned text, and it moves when objectui#13386 lands and the pin bumps.
- **Renderer lag — acceptable under the ruling.** On this head the renderer still draws empty rows for a `false` all-empty section in read-only mode, so the describe text runs ahead of the renderer. The ruling ordered exactly this sequence (spec text first; objectui#13386 carries `Blocked-by:` this card and sits `pm:blocked`), so the text is the ruled contract, not an advertised capability nobody ordered. See ③.
- **Landing posture — right.** Head repo equals base repo (not a fork); no governed path in the file list; the PR is draft and was never readied, queued or armed; the `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, the claim gates and `Spec property liveness` are green on the head.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/25511-hide-empty-describe.md`: `@objectstack/spec` **`minor`**, with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: semantic` line-initial in the body; the PR body carries the same two lines. `Check Changeset` green.
- **Kind: `semantic` — right.** The meaning of an authorable value (`hideEmpty: false`) changes; no key is added, removed or tombstoned, no value refused, no default moved. **Level: `minor` — right.** A kind other than `none` takes at least `minor` on a package the diff moves, and the diff moves `@objectstack/spec`. Not `patch`, and not `skip-changeset` (the diff publishes).
- **`Clause-②: no`, no arm — right.** The accept set is unchanged, so neither `(widening)` nor `(narrowing)` applies; the changeset is non-breaking, no ADR-0087 marker is owed, and `check-adr-0087-registration` reads it as the one non-breaking changeset.
- The changeset body states the author-facing consequence (authored metadata needs no change; a `false` section keeps its heading), which is what the CHANGELOG needs to say for a semantic change.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none declared; none found.
- **Flag: the renderer lags the text until objectui#13386 lands — answered, ordered by ruling.** Comment 6369306878 on that card sequences spec text first and renderer second; comment 6370301339 records `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#25511` and the unlock scan on this card's close. Nothing for this PR to do.
- **Flag: the default sentence says "renders nothing at all" with no mode qualifier, while the renderer renders every row in edit mode for the default too — answered, not a FAIL point.** The wording pre-dates this PR (the old text said the same); the card ordered the default sentence kept as it is; the renderer's own comment documents `!isEditing` as a deliberate boundary ("what the contract governs is what a READER sees") and sdui.manifest.json already tells authors that inline-edit mode renders the section either way. It is not a metadata-authoring trap: the only metadata an author could write because of it is `false`, which keeps the heading and is harmless. If the lane seat wants the default sentence to carry the same mode split the `false` clause now carries, that is a follow-up describe-text card at p3, a doc nit; this read-only review files nothing.
- **Flag: the stale comment in packages/spec/src/ui/component.test.ts lines 635 to 638 ("the only spelling that keeps a section's label skeleton") — answered, not a blocker.** It is a comment, no assertion reads it, and the file is outside the claim's declared surface, where the dev correctly stopped. A later spec touch or the objectui#13386 follow-up can reword it.
- **Dev-declared deviations:** (a) the origin/main merge — the net diff against the merge-base is exactly the three files; (b) the unshallow on the shared clone and (c) the stray pid file at the filesystem root are outside the tree (the file list is three paths) and outside this review; (d) `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` NOT MEASURED locally is covered by `Lint & Repo Gates` success on the head, and `check:dev-prereqs` is local-only; (e) the attribution-trailer choice is not a contract matter; (f) `test:repo` not run locally is covered by `Test Core` success.
- Wording calls 1 and 2 are judged right in ①.
